issue.notes:
Defect evidence (from beadrs-6a4cf9bf verification, 2026-10-26, clean extraction of cb2f5228 + the set-v2 test rewrites):

D1 - set-v2 corpus writer rejects acknowledged redaction findings.
  Repro: tests/redaction_storage.rs every_redaction_record_round_trips_through_sharded_restore; `bead sync flush-only` after planting the 5-record redaction corpus exits 1: "Internal error: duplicate record ID bbbb... in set-v2 corpus" (src/service/checkpoint/set_v2.rs:142).
  Root cause: a redaction acknowledgment's canonical identity key is its finding's fingerprint, and the redaction class partitions findings and acknowledgments in one prefix space, so the pair collides as duplicate record IDs.
  Verified fix already exists as UNCOMMITTED working-tree WIP (2026-10-26): keyed_record_id namespaces redaction_acknowledgment IDs via sha256("redaction_acknowledgment\0<id>") - src/service/checkpoint/set_v2.rs. With it the whole redaction_storage target passes 5/5.

D2 - retained redaction lookup rejects set-v2 pointers.
  Repro: tests/redaction_publication.rs retained_checkpoint_issue_fingerprint_redacts_live_description (sharded leg) and tests/redact_all_blocking.rs all_blocking_defers_unresolvable_close_event_findings_until_publication / all_blocking_sweeps_secrets_carried_by_close_events / all_blocking_sweeps_identical_secrets_across_duplicate_issues: `bead redact` exits "Integrity error: could not scan retained checkpoint redaction targets"; the swallowed cause is Integrity("checkpoint pointer has unsupported mode") - find_retained_checkpoint_findings dispatches through checkpoint_issue_paths (src/service/secret_diagnostics.rs), which at cb2f5228 has no set-v2 arm.
  Verified fix already exists as UNCOMMITTED working-tree WIP: a "set-v2" arm in checkpoint_issue_paths scanning the manifest's class=="issue" shards. With it (plus D1's fix) all three redaction targets pass 11/11, 5/5, 5/5 in the parent verification env (unshare -rm, tmpfs over /var/tmp AND /tmp, TMPDIR=/tmp, BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER on).

Both fixes were verified in a private extraction; they remain uncommitted in /home/coding/bead-rs as of 2026-10-26 ~13:00 EDT, co-present with unrelated rival WIP (build.rs, src/main.rs, src/service/doctor.rs, src/service/git.rs). Related: beadrs-16a8b38e owns the set-v2 publication-fault/restore-corpus findings family - coordinate before reimplementing; the WIP may be its earlier dispatch's deliverable.

Acceptance when admitted: land the two src fixes (or equivalents) on a clean build; then UNPIN the five legs gated/ignored in tests/redaction_storage.rs, tests/redaction_publication.rs, tests/redact_all_blocking.rs by beadrs-6a4cf9bf - each carries a contract note naming this bead - and pass all three targets unpinned in the parent verification env.
